answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in knoll, checked in pearl, and shale exposes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 10 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2163 identities would post 4426 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
